Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Interactive Waiting Room Mini Game: Rebuild the waiting screen with a stage layout featuring an interactive pet preview and tips while generation processes. (why: The median wait time in the home step is 201s (mean 2336s), causing heavy drop-off during background rendering.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Quiz Screen: Insert a short personality quiz screen before photo upload to help users tailor their pet behavior. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% and support receives complaints about custom pets feeling wrong or failing.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Guided Path Recommendation Flow: Add a pre-path guidance screen to help undecided users pick between quick preset pets and custom creations. (why: The choose_path step has an extremely high mean duration of 514s, pointing to indecision during path selection.)
3: [home, notification] Background Generation Desktop Alert: Enable completion notifications and time estimation on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app. (why: The waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s); desktop alerts let users safely switch tasks without abandoning setup.)
4: [sign_in, layout] One-Click Quick Sign In Layout: Switch the sign-in screen to a compact layout with progress indicators for instant authentication visual feedback. (why: 27.1% of users fail to convert at sign_in, and support noted reports of the sign-in screen stalling.)
